intro: Belarus is officially a presidential republic but in practice an authoritarian state.

chapters.title: Power and protest
text: Power is concentrated in the president. International observers say elections are not free or fair, independent media have been shut down, and human rights groups count more than a thousand political prisoners. Belarus is the only country in Europe that still carries out the death penalty.

chapters.title: Close to Russia
text: Belarus is in a 'Union State' with Russia, and Russian nuclear weapons have been stationed there since 2023. Opposition supporters use a white-red-white flag, different from the official red-and-green one.

keyTerms.meaning: A system where power is held by one leader or group without real democratic checks.
Someone jailed for their political views or activities.
